overallVerdict.summary: The video directly shows a Runway-like interface containing an already-loaded 10-second source clip, an English prompt, an In queue state, a Gen-3 Alpha result pane, and a 10-second animated result. It does not show an end-to-end one-minute workflow, a file-selection/upload action, prompt entry, generation submission, elapsed generation time, completion event, or any export/download action. The visible queue message says the video will start in a few minutes, which conflicts with treating the on-screen one-minute headline as a demonstrated guarantee.

demonstrationTimeline.observation: Fast split-screen comparison montage labelled AI生成 above and 实拍 below. It shows several stylized/action examples but no provenance, settings, generation interaction, or timing for those examples.
Edited monitor shot of an already-loaded source clip and an In queue panel. The source player reports a 10-second duration. No file picker or upload progress is shown.

The edit zooms to the source player and a pre-existing English prompt. Yellow Chinese text is an editorial translation overlay, not text entered into the product UI. No typing or generate click is shown.
A cut reveals source and animated result side by side. This establishes that a result is displayed, not how long its generation took or that it was generated during this recording.
The edit zooms into the result pane. Gen-3 Alpha is visible, the result player reports 10 seconds, and a toast reads You're ready to generate. No export or download action occurs.
